selection_rationale: CAND-001 directly targets the core identified gap (CG1/CG2): empirical evaluation of verifier-guided generate–validate–repair pipelines for NetOps by measuring executable safety in a packet-level simulator. It offers a falsifiable, paired design with clear primary outcome, strong venue relevance, and feasible model-call budget; the critic reviews identify concrete, fixable design repairs rather than fatal flaws.
unresolved_uncertainties: Transferability of generate–validate–repair gains from IaC/code domains to network-device configuration execution (related to evidence-synthesis UQ1).
Degree to which packet-level simulator fidelity maps to production-impact labels (what simulator-observed failures truly mean operationally).
Representativeness and potential leakage of the intent corpus relative to any verifier/repair/RAG corpora (risk of biased improvement estimates).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify deterministic verifier formalism: enumerate exact syntactic and semantic invariants (syntax, loop detection, reachability checks, policy-conflict rules), formal definitions, and pass/fail thresholds.

Declare exact simulator and orchestration: tool and version (e.g., Mininet version X or specified packet-level simulator), topology templates, execution harness, and precise mapping from simulator observations to the binary 'executable-safety' label (numeric thresholds for service outage, reachability loss, etc.).
Document intent-corpus provenance and sampling: full sources, sampling procedure, train/test separation from any retrieval/repair corpora, and a hash manifest for all corpus files to prevent leakage.

Freeze and record model/runtime parameters in the preregistration: exact LLM model identifier(s), API/provider, prompt templates, temperature and other hyperparameters, seeds, retry policy, and max repair iterations.

Pre-register repair-evaluation instrumentation: always run verifier re-check after each repair, log repair diffs, detect and report repair-induced regressions, and define acceptance/rejection rules for repaired configs.
